info.title: App Store Connect (read)
info.description: Read-only App Store Connect cockpit — apps, TestFlight builds, App Store versions/review state, customer reviews, beta groups/testers, and sales reports. No write endpoints.
info.x-cli-description: A read-only App Store Connect cockpit across all your apps: review state, TestFlight builds, ratings, reviews, and downloads.
info.x-auth-instructions: JWT (ES256) bearer. Create an App Store Connect API key (Users and Access > Integrations > App Store Connect API), download the .p8, and set ASC_KEY_ID, ASC_ISSUER_ID, and ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH (or ASC_PRIVATE_KEY). Keys are scoped to one team; run one team per invocation.
